newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: COMMERCIAL BANK TO BE SOLD FOR 400 LTL - REPORT.
newsitem.headline: COMMERCIAL BANK TO BE SOLD FOR 400 LTL - REPORT.

text.p: Lithuania's State Commercial Bank will be sold for a symbolic sum of 400 litas, the daily Lietuvos rytas reported on Monday.
"It was decided to sell the bank for 400 litas," the paper quoted Finance Minister Algirdas Shemeta was quoted as saying.
"Of course the investor will have to take the respective obligations," Shemeta said.
The bank's losses in 1996 were over 170 million litas.
The government launched a privatisation tender last week for the bank and the deadline to submit applications expires at the beginning of July.
"I expect that the bank will be sold before the end of this year," Shemeta was quoted as saying.
The government also said earlier that it will privatise the Agricultural Bank.
